dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave curvature on the trailing edge exhibiting a moderate falcate spline from the mid-point to the apex.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded geometry with a wide pixel radius; lacks acute tapering at the highest morphological point.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Posteriorly inclined margin approximately 50-55 degrees relative to the horizontal dorsal ridge line.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.5:1 ratio of longitudinal base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Low-curvature convex arc extending from the anterior cranial boundary to the rostrum base.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short, tapered protrusion with a high thickness-to-length ratio relative to the cranial volume.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle (approx. 140-150 degrees) at the transition from the melon slope to the dorsal rostrum surface.
